name: Nintendo Switch
description: The settings given to Citron before every Switch game starts.

resolution.label: Render resolution
resolution.description: The size Citron draws at, as a multiple of the console's own picture (1080p docked, 720p handheld). “Follow the stream” draws at the resolution chosen for the game: 540p gives 0.5×, 720p gives 0.75×.

consoleMode.label: Console mode
consoleMode.description: Handheld draws at 720p instead of 1080p, and some games lower their detail too: lighter for a phone.

asyncShaders.label: Asynchronous shaders
asyncShaders.description: Shaders are built in the background instead of pausing the game. A few frames may miss an effect while one is being built.

gpuAccuracy.label: GPU accuracy
gpuAccuracy.description: Low is the fastest and may show glitches; High fixes some games and costs more.

cpuAccuracy.label: CPU accuracy
cpuAccuracy.description: Unsafe skips some checks for speed; Accurate and Paranoid fix rare games and cost more.

vsync.label: Vertical sync
vsync.description: Off shows each frame as soon as it is ready: less latency, possible tearing.

multiCore.label: Multi-core CPU emulation
multiCore.description: The Switch's cores run on separate threads. Off is only useful to work around a game that misbehaves with it.

antiAliasing.label: Anti-aliasing
antiAliasing.description: Smooths jagged edges after the picture is drawn; None costs nothing.

scalingFilter.label: Scaling filter
scalingFilter.description: How the picture is resized to the screen. FSR sharpens an upscaled picture and costs a little.

videoDecoding.label: Video decoding
videoDecoding.description: How in-game videos are decoded. Off skips them, which helps a game that freezes on a video.

reactiveFlushing.label: Reactive flushing
reactiveFlushing.description: Keeps what some games read back from the picture correct. Off is faster, and a few games show wrong shadows or lighting.

volume.label: Volume
volume.description: Citron's own volume, before the stream's.

turnipDebug.label: Adreno driver workaround (Turnip)
turnipDebug.description: A debug option of Turnip, the graphics driver of Adreno phones: it changes how the driver renders, to work around its bugs. It has no effect on another graphics processor.

options.flushall: flushall — empty the GPU caches after every draw (slower)
options.syncdraw: syncdraw — one draw at a time (slow)

ir3Debug.label: Adreno shader compiler (Turnip)
ir3Debug.description: A debug option of ir3, the compiler of Turnip's shaders. “nopreamble” works around a known geometry bug of RPCS3 on Turnip (Mesa #14386). It has no effect on another graphics processor.
